hook.line: This is a functioning ecosystem I built for my AI agents so I can see what they're doing.
hook.visual: Phone filming a monitor in a pink room; a pixel-art 'factory' dashboard with tiny agent sprites fills the screen as the camera pushes in.

beats.what: Camera pushes toward a monitor showing a pixel-art agent factory dashboard
Foam pointer hand on a stick taps the Etsy conveyor belt; ~$2,000 revenue claim
Points to the 'Vybes' music-studio room that makes deep house for Spotify and YouTube
Plays the agent's YouTube visualiser on a laptop as proof
Cuts to a real Fiverr thumbnail seller's gig page and mocks his unfinished orders
Shows the $55 gig price and explains his own agent-run Fiverr clone
Next room: 2D game asset bundles copied from a paid store listing
Newsletter and marketing rooms, quick tour back across the factory
Asks for 1,000 likes in exchange for a full tour video

characters.who: Foam pointer hand on a stick (novelty prop)
characters.enters: Pokes in from the bottom right of frame when he starts pointing at the Etsy room
characters.acts: Taps each factory room, gig page and price he talks about, like a teacher's pointer
characters.exits: Drops out of frame during laptop and browser shots

why_it_works: Pixel-art game-like dashboard makes invisible AI agents visible as little workers, so a technical idea reads as a toy
Real money numbers (about $2,000, 37 orders, $55 gigs) anchor each room in a result
Rivalry story ('what if I took this guy's job') adds a villain and emotion to a feature tour
Constant handheld push-ins (20 punches per minute) keep a 3-minute single shot from feeling static
weaknesses: 179 s with no captions and quiet audio (-23.4 LUFS) loses sound-off viewers
Filming a monitor with a phone makes small UI text unreadable
Swearing and mocking a named seller may limit reach and brand safety
Engagement-bait ending ('1,000 likes for a full tour') instead of a clear follow or link CTA
for_robert: The pixel-art 'factory' with agent sprites is exactly his lane: let Fred act as the pointer, swimming to each room or number as he names it, entering and exiting like the foam hand does.
